title: Chapter 7
text: It is the valley above Riorson House, heated by natural thermal energy, that is its greatest asset. For there lie the original hatching grounds of the Dubhmadinn Line, from which two of the greatest dragons of our time—Codagh and Tairn—descend. —C OLONEL K AORI’S F IELD G UIDE TO D RAGONKIND
